en: If we meet here again, tomorrow or after,
I shall tell you about it then.
Today I was to tell you
about my dream, wasn't I?
You see, I wish to dig a tunnel
for a railway to run through.
And not just any ordinary tunnel,
but an undersea tunnel joining two nations.
An undersea tunnel...
Indeed... An undersea tunnel linking
England and France.
This is no mere old man's delusion;
with modern science, it is an entirely
achievable undertaking.
But approval is hard to come by,
so here I am, rushing about to prepare.
The undersea tunnel could be finished
in five years. Yet permission won't come.
And why is that?
It is because our people all fear
the nation of France.
They think a railway would rob them
of the natural fortress we call the sea.
As long as such ideas rule public opinion,
building the tunnel may be difficult.
Even so, I won't give up.
The undersea tunnel is my dream.
Someday, I will surely make it real,
you'll see. Its convenience will
astound the whole world.
Though to someone as young as you,
that may not mean much.
Just what sort of endeavour
do you intend to undertake?
Oh, pardon me. It seems I'm out of time.
Who's there...?
...Can it be? An angel from heaven?
Why, you're
note: Maurice recognizes the intruder; + {NAME} + #3363 '.' -> 'Why, you're Chris.'

en: How did you get into my room?
The house is locked up tight at night.
I truly am an angel.
Only not from heaven. From hell.
note: No used_in; follows #6120 after a pause and line break in msg 247689 (per msg.py).

en: Good grief, what a joke.
Why would I make such a joke?
Surely,
note: After six '.' fragments (#265) with pauses: '......Surely, you don't truly mean to / kill me?'

en: you don't truly mean to
kill me?
I won't kill you.
I'll only be taking your nights, that's all.
W-what are you doing...!!
I'm sorry...
I'm a newspaper reporter.
I've been out to unmask the Ripper
who's got the whole city in an uproar.
Hi. I'm out to unmask the Ripper
who's got the whole city in an uproar.
If you know anything about the Ripper,
tell me, will you?
I gather witness statements and what
little info there is, and dig on my own
to track Jack's movements.
At a pub in the Westminster district,
I got all sorts of testimony.
There's a chance he's lying low
somewhere around there.
The police and public had Lenny the tanner
down as a suspect for Jack, it seems, but
by my investigation, he's not the culprit.
With so much information flying around,
some folks get confused, but not me.
When I get a lead, I go check it out
in person, on my own two feet.
Seeing is believing, after all.
That's why I get closest to the truth.
The police and self-styled detectives
are after Jack, but nobody catches him.
But now, I've started to get interested
in something else...
A vampire... a bloodsucking vampire
is said to be here in this city.
